div.div: وَغْرَةٌ , (S, K,) and وَغْرَةُ حَرٍّ, (Msb,) Intenseness, or vehemence, of heat: (Msb, K:) or of the burning thereof, (S, TA,) when the sun is in the meridian. (TA.) You say, نَزَلْنَا فِى وَغْرَةِ القَيْطِ عَلَى مَآءِ كَذَا We alighted during the intense midday heat at such a water. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
